description: This file defines the MqttContext class, which encapsulates relevant information during processing of MQTT messages in the Eclipse Hono project. It manages message details, endpoint info, device authentication, topics, property bags, and measurement timers.

classes.name: MqttContext
classes.description: A dictionary of relevant information required during the processing of an MQTT message, including message details, device info, topic, property bag, and measurement timer.

methods.name: fromPublishPacket
methods.description: Creates a new MqttContext instance from a published MQTT message and device endpoint, optionally including an authenticated device.

methods.name: fromConnectPacket
methods.description: Creates a new MqttContext instance for a connection attempt using the provided endpoint.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the MQTT publish message associated with this context.

methods.name: deviceEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint over which the message was received.

methods.name: authenticatedDevice
methods.description: Returns the authenticated device associated with the message, if any.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: topic
methods.description: Returns the resource identifier representing the message's topic.

methods.name: tenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the device or topic.

methods.name: propertyBag
methods.description: Returns the property bag extracted from the topic, if any.

methods.name: endpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint type derived from the topic.

methods.name: isAtLeastOnce
methods.description: Checks whether the message was published with QoS 1.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends a PUBACK to acknowledge message receipt.

methods.name: setTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer object for measuring processing duration.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the timer object used for measuring processing duration.
